text:
lucas: Quick bench ask — can someone run a short smoke to measure overhead for streaming + tool-calls vs non-streaming on RT API and on Dedicated? looking for p50/p95 token latency, end-to-end response time, and tokens/sec. focus on small (<=128 tokens) and medium (512 tokens) outputs.

priya: Yep I can take the small/med payloads. do you want cold KV vs warmed cache comparisons too?

lucas: Yes — include both cold (first request after restart) and warm (repeat after 20 requests). Also test: (A) streaming + tool call, (B) non-streaming + tool call, (C) streaming no tool, (D) non-streaming no tool. Keep model same across runs.

mark: For consistency: what concurrency and batch cap should we use? can vary but report those. I'd suggest concurrency=8, batch_cap=32 to mimic production.

lucas: +1 to mark's defaults. please also run a single-run with concurrency=1 to measure minimal latency. record GPU util / CPU core % if possible.

anna: where's the test harness? I can kick off runs from my laptop but want the script.

lucas: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-sync (bench/run_overhead.sh). example command:```bash
# small payload streaming + tool
bench/run_overhead.sh --mode streaming --toolcall true --model redwood-1-std --payloads tests/payloads/small.json --concurrency 8 --batch-cap 32 --runs 5 --report out/small_stream_tool.json
```Include the output JSON and a brief summary in this thread.

bench-bot: scheduled job created: bench-job-1769123456 -- will post status updates here. :rocket:

devops: for Dedicated runs, pin to pool "dedicated-gpu-pool-a" and quant variant "q4_0" so variants match. I can provision ephemeral nodes if you need more capacity.

priya: running now on hosted RT first (concurrency=8). will post stripped results: p50/p95/mean tokens/sec + notes on lat spikes.

josh: did a quick 1-run (concurrency=1) for small streaming+tool on Dedicated (q4_0). results: p50=56ms, p95=120ms, e2e=180ms, tokens/sec=420. GPU util ~54%. attaching raw out: out/dedicated_small_stream_tool.json (uploaded).

lucas: awesome — can you paste the short summary numbers here @josh? I'll add to the spreadsheet. also please note whether tool call added a round-trip to our tool service or was simulated.

josh: pasted above — tool call was simulated (local stub) so network overhead excluded.

mark: reminder — when you post results, include exact bench args + model git hash. small differences matter.

priya: hosted RT run done. summary (small streaming+tool, concurrency=8): p50=72ms, p95=210ms, e2e=290ms, tokens/sec=360. cold cache p95 ~450ms on first request. attaching out/hosted_small_stream_tool.json.

lucas: perfect. next steps: (1) volunteers to run medium payloads on Dedicated q4_0, (2) someone to run non-streaming variants so we can compute delta. I'll compile a short table. @anna want to take (1)? :slightly_smiling_face:

anna: I can run the medium on Dedicated later today. estimate ~30–45m.

lucas: thanks all — please drop the small JSONs and a 1-line summary (p50/p95/tokens/sec) here when done. I'll cut a quick chart and open a tiny PR to add results to the perf dashboard. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

bench-bot: bench-job-1769123456 completed (partial). results links: out/hosted_small_stream_tool.json, out/dedicated_small_stream_tool.json

priya: note for future: streaming adds ~10–20% overhead for small outputs but helps CPU/GPU pipelining at higher concurrency. include that observation in the doc.

lucas: noted. thanks everyone — collecting final numbers by EOD. if anyone runs into flaky p95s, ping me with the raw logs and I'll help triage. :+1:
